description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Holidays API resource in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for holiday-related endpoints.

classes.name: HolidaysApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes defining Swagger schemas for holiday API requests and responses.

classes.name: GetHolidaysResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response returned when retrieving holiday data.

classes.name: PostHolidaysRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new holiday request.

classes.name: PostHolidaysRequestOffices
classes.description: Nested schema for specifying offices when creating a holiday.

classes.name: PostHolidaysResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a holiday.

classes.name: PostHolidaysHolidayIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for request involving a specific holiday ID.

classes.name: PostHolidaysHolidayIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response involving a specific holiday ID.

classes.name: PutHolidaysHolidayIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating a holiday's details.

classes.name: PutHolidaysHolidayIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a holiday.

classes.name: DeleteHolidaysHolidayIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a holiday.

methods.name: HolidaysApiResourceSwagger
methods.description: Contains only static inner classes defining API schemas; no instance methods.
